scope: Scoped kitchen casting, bearing and live-water review; not whole-world photorealism or owner acceptance.

images.observation: Rounded standard bowl, open drain bore and parked plug; the rear bearing rail no longer enters the basin.
Plug seated on ferrule, with a single rounded water surface inside the standard bowl.
Compact rolled lip bears on the countertop; rounded water stays within the bowl.
Compact bowl and drainboard sit on the revised source-owned support frame.
Standard upper-floor sink keeps its frame and outboard bearing rails beneath the rolled rim.
